name: url
label: URL
help: A path relative to https://privatusanalytics.com, like /sites/pa_7Q2K9XH3AB/stats/aggregate.json. It must start with a slash. Every endpoint is listed at https://privatusanalytics.com/docs/api.

name: method
label: Method
help: The HTTP method. Deleting data is not available in this module.

name: qs
label: Query String
help: Query string parameters, like period = 30d. For a list, write the key with brackets, like status[], once for each value.

name: body
label: Body
help: The request body as JSON, for POST, PATCH and PUT.
